label: to review
Proposed: Franken
research: The archival abstract of a late-sixteenth-century copy records an 80-gulden payment by Michael Rosenberger toward 300 gulden of accrued dues, with the receipt attributed to Elector Philipp. The same name, year and Palatine financial setting recur in 1507_4.json and fit the elector’s Oggersheim Schultheiß, active in the same year in 1507-06-24.json. The receipt gives no office, place or relative. The shared name, year and Palatine context support a probable identification with moderate confidence. Franken follows the likely Bauland connection of the father named in 1497-03-21.json (compare 1490-10-28.json). The Rosenegg surname parallel supplies no equivalent tie to these Palatine transactions.

entries.german:
Quittung [Kurfürst Philipps von der Pfalz] für 80 Gulden, die Michael Rosenberger der Pfalz als Teil von 300 Gulden aufgelaufener Gülten ausgerichtet hat.

Laufzeit: 1507 (Bezieht sich auf die Vorlage, hier Abschrift Ende 16. Jh.)

Receipt [of Elector Philipp of the Palatinate] for 80 gulden that Michael Rosenberger paid to the Palatinate as part of 300 gulden in accrued revenues.

facts.content: paid the Palatinate 80 gulden toward accrued rents.
